Contractor shall also perform any additional services [CLIENT_NAME] reasonably requests during the Term at no additional charge.
findings.explanation: This clause forces you to do extra work requested by the client during the contract term for free, exposing you to unlimited unpaid work and scope creep.
findings.suggested_change: Propose removing this clause or specifying that any additional services requested outside the scope of work will be billed at your standard hourly rate via a written change order.

findings.quoted_text: [CLIENT_NAME] may request unlimited revisions until [CLIENT_NAME] is fully satisfied with each Deliverable.
findings.explanation: Offering unlimited revisions until the client is fully satisfied means the project can drag on indefinitely with endless changes without extra compensation.
findings.suggested_change: Limit the number of included revision rounds (e.g., up to two rounds of revisions per milestone) and state that additional revisions will be billed at an hourly rate.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I am looking forward to moving forward and have a few minor requests regarding the agreement. - Regarding the relevant clause on additional services, the current terms require extra work without additional compensation, so I propose specifying that any additional services requested outside the scope of work will be billed at the standard hourly rate via a written change order. - Regarding the relevant clause on revisions, the current terms permit unlimited revisions, so I propose limiting the number of included revision rounds to up to two rounds per milestone and stating that additional revisions will be billed at an hourly rate. Thank you, and I look forward to getting started.
